  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_losses = losses * weight\n        loss = ops.sum(weighted_losses) / ops.sum(weight)\n    else:\n        loss = ops.sum(losses)\n    return loss\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise losses to a rank-gap based paradigm using the advantage signals and a smooth tanh link to penalize ranking errors proportionally to rank gap magnitude.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(advantage_w - advantage_l)\nscaled_gap = clamp(alpha * rank_gap, -10, 10)\nloss_per_pair = relu(tanh(scaled_gap) - (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))\nweighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight\nfinal_loss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_gap",

  },

    ],

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n\n    gap_raw = adv_w - adv_l\n    rg = ops.rank_gap(gap_raw)\n    scaled_rg = ops.clamp(alpha * rg, -10.0, 10.0)\n    link_val = ops.tanh(scaled_rg)\n    diff_log_prob = lpw - lpl\n    raw_loss = ops.relu(link_val - diff_log_prob)\n\n    if weight is not None:\n        raw_loss = raw_loss * weight\n\n    return ops.mean(raw_loss)"
}

  "name": "pairwise_pref_cost_gap",

    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']

    abs_gap = ops.abs(cost_gap) + epsilon

  "intuition": "To fix numerical instability due to potentially very small or zero cost_gap values, we clamp the denominator to a minimum epsilon (1e-6) before taking the reciprocal.     cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']

    scaled_diff = diff * weight * scale

    # Clamp scaled_diff to stabilize logsigmoid

    loss = ops.mean(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff_clamped))

  "intuition": "Stabilize loss by clamping margin adjusted with advantage_gap and a shift, normalize weights to sum to one for consistent gradients.",
  "pseudocode": "normalized_weight = weight / sum(weight + eps)\nmargin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nadjusted_margin = margin + beta * advantage_gap - shift\nclamped_margin = clamp(adjusted_margin, -15, 15)\nloss = -mean(logsigmoid(clamped_margin) * normalized_weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized_normalized",
    "other_hparams": "alpha fixed to 1.0, beta tunable, shift = 0.5"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "mean",
    "sum",
    "div"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-12\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.1)))\n    shift = float(extra.get('shift', 0.5))\n    margin = lpw - lpl\n    adjusted_margin = margin + beta * adv_gap - shift\n    clamped = ops.clamp(adjusted_margin, -15.0, 15.0)\n    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight) + eps\n    normalized_weight = weight / weight_sum\n    loss_per_pair = -ops.logsigmoid(clamped) * normalized_weight\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"
}

  "intuition": "This loss introduces a paradigm shift by combining pairwise probability differences with a soft ranking consistency constraint based on delta_regret, using a sigmoid link to create a smooth probabilistic penalty.   "pseudocode": "norm_regret = clamp(delta_regret / (max_abs_delta_regret + epsilon), -1, 1)\ndiff_margin = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - alpha * norm_regret\nloss_per_pair = weight * softplus(-beta * diff_margin)\nloss = sum(loss_per_pair) / (sum(weight) + epsilon)",

  "intuition": "Penalize insufficient margin inversely proportional to the cost gap, emphasizing pairs with small cost gap to encourage sharper separations. The margin is inverted relative to cost gap, weighted by pair importance, aggregated as weighted log-sigmoid loss using cost_gap.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\ninv_margin = cost_gap / (abs(margin) + epsilon)\nx = alpha * inv_margin - beta\nloss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)\nweighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight\nloss = weighted_mean(weighted_loss, weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_inverse_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "margin_penalty_inverse_cost_gap"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "add",
    "neg",
    "sum",
    "abs",
    "div",
    "clamp"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)\n    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros))\n    cost_gap = ops.clamp(cost_gap, min=eps)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))\n\n    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    abs_margin = ops.abs(margin)\n    inv_margin = ops.div(cost_gap, ops.add(abs_margin, eps))\n    x = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, inv_margin), beta)\n\n    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)\n    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss) / ops.sum(weight.clamp(min=eps))\n    return loss"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_002_cost_shifted_mean_repaired",
  "intuition": "Fixed affine invariance violation by normalizing cost_gap and scaling the margin offset adaptively. Since the subtraction of 0.1*(cost_b - cost_a) introduces affine sensitivity, we instead normalize cost_gap by its batch mean absolute value plus a small epsilon, ensuring consistent scale, and multiply by a tuned scalar. This stabilizes the loss under affine transformations of the cost signals while preserving the pairwise log-sigmoid margin structure, meeting co_gate invariance requirements.",
  "pseudocode": "mean(-logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw - lpl) - k * (cost_b - cost_a) / (mean(abs(cost_b - cost_a)) + eps), -20, 20)) * weight)\nwhere k is a fixed scalar (e.g. 0.1)",
  "hyperparams": {

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    k = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('k', 0.1))\n    eps = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('eps', 1e-6))\n\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = cost_b - cost_a\n    abs_gap = ops.abs(gap)\n    mean_abs_gap = ops.mean(abs_gap) + eps\n    normalized_gap = gap / mean_abs_gap\n\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - k * normalized_gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x) * weight\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}
